tradition_assertions.notes: Archive-reviewed work/title crosswalk: the Church's listed entry is ‘I and II Samuel’; TAU's source information identifies its digitized Ethiopic Reigns I–IV as ‘Samuel I–II and Kings I–II,’ and the two retained components are Regum I and II. This supports the named-work crosswalk only. The TAU equivalence remains attributed to TAU; it does not establish identity with a current EOTC edition, manuscript completeness, or wording accuracy. These component readers remain research records, not canon-linked coverage.

witness.title: I Samuel — Geʽez transcription of TAU's Dillmann Regum I
witness.date_statement: August Dillmann (ed.), Veteris Testamenti Aethiopici Tomus Secundus, fasc. 1: Regum I et II, Leipzig, 1861; text digitized by Ran HaCohen at Tel Aviv University.
witness.editorial_policy: The Ethiopic text spans were extracted from 31 retained TAU chapter HTML pages. HTML entities were decoded and whitespace normalized to single spaces. Each displayed source number and external book identifier is retained; no verse numbering is repaired, translated, or aligned to another witness.

coverage.structure_description: TAU's retained index lists Regum I chapters 1–31.
